mkdir -p /app/output && cat > /app/output/gen.py <<'PY'
"""Live controller for VLABench select_poker_spatial (instance i00).

Uses only the standard RCB client observations and absolute joint targets.
Run with --observe to capture current observations, or --hold to hold the
current joint pose. The episode is not reset by this script.
"""
import argparse
import json
import os
import numpy as np
from rcb_client import Robot


def observation(r, cameras=("forward", "left", "right", "wrist"), depth=False):
    return r.get_obs(cameras=list(cameras), include_depth=depth, video="frames")


def current_joint_target(r):
    p = r.get_obs(cameras=[], video="none").meta["proprio"]["now"]
    return np.array([p[f"joint{i}_pos"] for i in range(1, 8)] +
                    [p["finger1_pos"], p["finger2_pos"]], dtype=float)


def send_targets(r, targets, dt=0.1, cameras=None, video="none", note=""):
    return r.submit("joint_position", np.asarray(targets, dtype=float), dt=dt,
                    interpolate="linear", cameras=cameras, video=video, note=note)


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--observe", action="store_true")
    ap.add_argument("--hold", type=float, default=0.0, help="hold current joint pose for seconds")
    ap.add_argument("--out", default="/app/output/live")
    args = ap.parse_args()
    r = Robot()
    print(json.dumps({"spec": r.spec(), "status": r.status()}, default=str))
    if args.observe:
        res = observation(r, depth=True)
        os.makedirs(args.out, exist_ok=True)
        res.save(args.out)
        print(json.dumps(res.meta, default=str))
    if args.hold:
        target = current_joint_target(r)
        n = max(1, round(args.hold / r.spec()["control_dt"]))
        res = send_targets(r, np.repeat(target[None, :], n, axis=0), note="hold current pose")
        print(json.dumps(res.meta, default=str))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
PY

*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+"""Empirical joint-space controller for select_poker_spatial, instance i00.
+
+This controller uses only the standard RCB client, robot proprioception, and
+camera observations. It estimates the local hand Jacobian by small joint
+motions, then uses damped differential IK for short Cartesian moves.
+"""
+import argparse
+import json
+import os
+import time
+import numpy as np
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+
+CAL_FILE = "/app/output/jacobian.json"
+
+
+def state(r):
+    res = r.get_obs(cameras=[], video="none")
+    p = res.meta["proprio"]["now"]
+    q = np.array(p[:7], dtype=float)
+    fingers = np.array(p[14:16], dtype=float)
+    xyz = np.array(p[16:19], dtype=float)
+    quat = np.array(p[19:23], dtype=float)  # w, x, y, z
+    cmd = np.array(p[23:32], dtype=float)
+    return {"q": q, "fingers": fingers, "xyz": xyz, "quat": quat,
+            "cmd": cmd, "meta": res.meta}
+
+
+def quaternion_normalize(q):
+    q = np.asarray(q, dtype=float)
+    return q / np.linalg.norm(q)
+
+
+def quaternion_multiply(a, b):
+    aw, ax, ay, az = a
+    bw, bx, by, bz = b
+    return np.array([aw*bw-ax*bx-ay*by-az*bz,
+                     aw*bx+ax*bw+ay*bz-az*by,
+                     aw*by-ax*bz+ay*bw+az*bx,
+                     aw*bz+ax*by-ay*bx+az*bw])
+
+
+def quaternion_inverse(q):
+    q = quaternion_normalize(q)
+    return q * np.array([1., -1., -1., -1.])
+
+
+def quaternion_rotation_vector(q):
+    q = quaternion_normalize(q)
+    if q[0] < 0:
+        q = -q
+    v = q[1:]
+    n = np.linalg.norm(v)
+    if n < 1e-10:
+        return 2.0 * v
+    return v * (2.0 * np.arctan2(n, np.clip(q[0], -1., 1.)) / n)
+
+
+def pose_delta(s, ref):
+    dp = s["xyz"] - ref["xyz"]
+    dq = quaternion_multiply(s["quat"], quaternion_inverse(ref["quat"]))
+    return np.r_[dp, quaternion_rotation_vector(dq)]
+
+
+def targets_from_q(q, aperture=0.04):
+    return np.r_[np.asarray(q, dtype=float), aperture, aperture]
+
+
+def move_joint_target(r, target, seconds=0.8, aperture=None, note=""):
+    start = state(r)
+    if aperture is None:
+        aperture = float(np.mean(start["fingers"]))
+    n_ramp = max(2, int(round(seconds / 0.1)) // 2)
+    n_hold = max(2, int(round(seconds / 0.1)) - n_ramp)
+    ramp = np.linspace(start["q"], np.asarray(target, dtype=float), n_ramp + 1)[1:]
+    rows = np.vstack([np.r_[q, aperture, aperture] for q in ramp] +
+                     [targets_from_q(target, aperture)] * n_hold)
+    return r.submit("joint_position", rows, dt=0.1, interpolate="linear",
+                    cameras=None, video="none", note=note)
+
+
+def calibrate(r, delta=0.07, settle_s=0.9):
+    base = state(r)
+    q0 = base["q"].copy()
+    samples_q, samples_x = [], []
+    for j in range(7):
+        for sign in (-1., 1.):
+            goal = q0.copy()
+            goal[j] += sign * delta
+            move_joint_target(r, goal, seconds=settle_s, aperture=0.04,
+                              note=f"local Jacobian probe joint {j+1} {sign:+.0f}")
+            s = state(r)
+            samples_q.append(s["q"] - q0)
+            samples_x.append(pose_delta(s, base))
+            move_joint_target(r, q0, seconds=settle_s, aperture=0.04,
+                              note="return to calibration pose")
+            state(r)
+            st = r.status()
+            if st.get("done"):
+                raise RuntimeError(f"episode ended during Jacobian calibration: {st}")
+            print(f"probe j{j+1} {sign:+.0f}: dq={np.round(samples_q[-1],4).tolist()} "
+                  f"dpose={np.round(samples_x[-1],4).tolist()}", flush=True)
+    D = np.asarray(samples_q, dtype=float).T
+    X = np.asarray(samples_x, dtype=float).T
+    J = X @ np.linalg.pinv(D, rcond=1e-5)
+    data = {"q0": q0.tolist(), "xyz0": base["xyz"].tolist(),
+            "quat0": base["quat"].tolist(), "J": J.tolist(),
+            "singular_values": np.linalg.svd(J, compute_uv=False).tolist(),
+            "created": time.time()}
+    with open(CAL_FILE, "w") as f:
+        json.dump(data, f, indent=2)
+    print("JACOBIAN", json.dumps(data, indent=2), flush=True)
+    return data
+
+
+def damped_step(J, error, damping=0.04):
+    # Thin SVD gives a damped least-squares inverse with controlled motion near
+    # singular arm configurations.
+    U, sv, Vt = np.linalg.svd(J, full_matrices=False)
+    gain = sv / (sv * sv + damping * damping)
+    return Vt.T @ (gain * (U.T @ error))
+
+
+def move_cartesian(r, goal_xyz, goal_quat=None, aperture=0.04,
+                   max_iters=35, pos_tol=0.008, rot_tol=0.12,
+                   step_cap=0.18, damping=0.04):
+    with open(CAL_FILE) as f:
+        cal = json.load(f)
+    J = np.asarray(cal["J"], dtype=float)
+    if goal_quat is None:
+        goal_quat = state(r)["quat"]
+    goal_quat = quaternion_normalize(goal_quat)
+    goal_xyz = np.asarray(goal_xyz, dtype=float)
+    for k in range(max_iters):
+        s = state(r)
+        ep = goal_xyz - s["xyz"]
+        er = quaternion_rotation_vector(quaternion_multiply(
+            goal_quat, quaternion_inverse(s["quat"])))
+        e = np.r_[ep, er]
+        print(f"IK {k}: xyz={np.round(s['xyz'],4).tolist()} "
+              f"poserr={np.round(ep,4).tolist()} roterr={np.round(er,3).tolist()} "
+              f"q={np.round(s['q'],3).tolist()}", flush=True)
+        if np.linalg.norm(ep) < pos_tol and np.linalg.norm(er) < rot_tol:
+            return s
+        dq = damped_step(J, e, damping=damping)
+        scale = min(1., step_cap / max(1e-9, np.linalg.norm(dq)))
+        dq *= scale
+        # Limit each correction and keep well inside Panda's actual joint range.
+        dq = np.clip(dq, -0.14, 0.14)
+        target = s["q"] + dq
+        limits = np.array([[-2.8973,2.8973],[-1.7628,1.7628],
+                           [-2.8973,2.8973],[-3.0718,-0.0698],
+                           [-2.8973,2.8973],[-0.0175,3.7525],
+                           [-2.8973,2.8973]])
+        target = np.clip(target, limits[:,0]+0.015, limits[:,1]-0.015)
+        move_joint_target(r, target, seconds=0.7, aperture=aperture,
+                          note=f"differential IK {k}")
+        st = r.status()
+        if st.get("done"):
+            raise RuntimeError(f"episode ended during Cartesian move: {st}")
+    return state(r)
+
+
+def main():
+    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    ap.add_argument("--calibrate", action="store_true")
+    ap.add_argument("--move", nargs=3, type=float, metavar=("X", "Y", "Z"))
+    ap.add_argument("--aperture", type=float, default=0.04)
+    ap.add_argument("--steps", type=int, default=35)
+    ap.add_argument("--observe", action="store_true")
+    ap.add_argument("--out", default="/app/output/live")
+    args = ap.parse_args()
+    r = Robot()
+    print("STATUS", json.dumps(r.status()), flush=True)
+    if args.calibrate:
+        calibrate(r)
+    if args.move:
+        s = state(r)
+        end = move_cartesian(r, args.move, goal_quat=s["quat"],
+                             aperture=args.aperture, max_iters=args.steps)
+        print("FINAL", json.dumps({k: np.asarray(v).tolist() if isinstance(v, np.ndarray) else v
+                                   for k, v in end.items()}, default=str), flush=True)
+    if args.observe:
+        os.makedirs(args.out, exist_ok=True)
+        res = r.get_obs(cameras=["forward", "left", "right", "wrist"],
+                        include_depth=True, video="frames")
+        res.save(args.out)
+        print("OBS", json.dumps(res.meta, default=str), flush=True)
+    print("STATUS", json.dumps(r.status()), flush=True)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
